design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (recovery_repossession_and_reinstatement, env_0072). Revision 2 (policy audit round 1 closed; see rework_claims_r2.md).
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,4] -> recovery_ext_surrender_fee=4, recovery_ext_reinstatement_expense_payment=4.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only to pay the surrender-side and storage charges herself before reinstating (her husband sends the missed installments by MoneyGram). The agent must read that the reinstatement expense payment waits on the voluntary surrender fee being posted, see no expense posted, post the fee (state limit, value taper, drop-off credit, surrender timing) and work the payment with four storage factors on the world after that write, then hand it over.
SCOPE: task 1 claims recovery_ext_surrender_fee and recovery_ext_reinstatement_expense_payment; task 0 owns the agency fee, the sale-notice period and the redemption payment. Disjoint and jointly complete.
PROBLEM TREE: root recovery_ext_reinstatement_expense_payment (owner=user). Edge -> recovery_ext_surrender_fee, value_input, gate posted_open, state form (affirmative): 'On a case whose vehicle the borrower surrendered voluntarily, the reinstatement expense payment is fixed only after the voluntary surrender fee stands posted on the case.'. False at opening: case d190b437-3350-4455-b489-a6abe10d6385 is voluntary_surrender with no expense row and expenses_outstanding_usd 0.00. Single writer: the surrender fee tool. Deletion sensitivity: skip fee -> 196.00 instead of 297.00. The fee can never post 0.00 (surrender_fee_minimum_usd floor), so the edge always moves the payment.
FACTOR CARD.
recovery_ext_surrender_fee (baseline class voluntary_surrender_fee_usd 175.00): surrender_state_ceiling tier 'the contract's state_code is one of surrender_limit_states_a' -> 150.00 (sens 126.00); surrender_value_basis tier 'the book value is at least surrender_low_value_threshold_usd but below surrender_mid_value_threshold_usd' -> taper 9.00 (sens 110.00); dropoff_delivery tier 'the case's storage_lot is one of company_dropoff_lots and the recovery_date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday' -> 25.00 (sens 126.00); surrender_timing tier 'it came in more than prompt_surrender_days but no more than timely_surrender_days calendar days after the opened_date' -> 15.00 (sens 116.00). Result 101.00; all-baseline 175.00. Near-misses: the 4-day lag misses the 3-day prompt tier; the Saturday drop takes the after-hours credit, not the staffed-lot credit.
recovery_ext_reinstatement_expense_payment (baseline posted open + class 30.00 x (9 - 2)): lot_day_rate tier 'the contract's state_code is one of rate_states_a' -> 20.00 (sens 367.00); lot_grace_days tier 'the case's storage_lot is one of no_grace_lots' -> 0 (sens 241.00); storage_clock_start tier 'the recovery_method is not impound_release and the recovery_date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday' -> 7 days (sens 353.00); keyless_lot_handling tier 'keys_obtained is false, no key_replacement_fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow_equipment is wheel_lift' -> 8.00 (sens 241.00). Result 297.00; all-baseline 311.00. Near-miss: the stated earliest sale date 2026-10-28 is later than the payment date and does not shorten the window; the notice's stated 755.15 is the amount due on the mailing date, not the payment.
CROSS-DIFFICULTY: contract state_code and vehicle_book_value_usd (CFIELD) on contract b5f88e7d-7340-4f2f-842f-0b858848d5f6. MULTI-SOURCE: keyless_lot_handling only (keys_obtained on the case, absence of a key_replacement_fee row in the activity, class tow_equipment). dropoff_delivery and lot_grace_days read fields of the one case row and are not claimed as multi-source.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: the fee needs recovered status (expense_case_status): recovered. The payment's base status gate is retired by the declared overwrite naming both borrower expense payments; reinstatement is available (no reinstated case, not charged off) and the payment date is before the earliest sale date 2026-10-28.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target case d190b437-3350-4455-b489-a6abe10d6385; posted_open sums only this case's rows.
SEED: contract simulated from origination 2023-06-20 (48 x 355.03 at 24.49%), one 2024 return with a 27.50 returned-payment fee (tier 25.00 + restriction review 5.00 + GA bank-charge recovery 2.50 - autopay offset 5.00) repaid in time, delinquent from 2026-08-22, late charges 5.33 and 9.76 (5.0% of 355.03, contract signed before the GA schedule date, less the combined autopay and first-delinquency reductions); voluntary surrender case; first notice consistent with the sale-period rule (15 days) and stating the amount due on its mailing date (755.15). Dealer agreement id is null (dealer profile cannot enter the closure).
PERSONA: Agnieszka Kowalczyk; volunteers the surrender, the wish to reinstate and to pay the surrender and storage side herself by debit card (certified channel); her husband's MoneyGram for the installments is a certified channel; credentials on request; reactive consent only; pays exactly the stated amount; ends at confirmation.
STANDARD SOLUTION: verify; read contract, ledger, case, activity; post surrender fee 101.00; hand over payment 297.00.
VERIFICATION: recomputed by check_compute.py (COMPUTE OK).
user_scenario: You are Agnieszka Kowalczyk, 35, a dental assistant in Decatur, Georgia. When you lost your job in early October you could not keep up with the payments on your 2013 Ford Expedition, so you asked Harborline on Tuesday, October 6 to take it back and on Saturday, October 10 you left it at Peachtree Auto Holding in Forest Park, the drop-off lot they gave you; you could not find the only key, so it went in without one. You start a new job next week and you want the Expedition back. You speak quickly and a bit anxiously, and you open by saying you surrendered your SUV and now want to reinstate and get it back. Your husband Tomasz is sending the missed loan payments himself by MoneyGram this evening, so you are not asking about those; what you want to do on this call is pay, yourself and right now, the charges on the repossession side for the surrender and the storage lot, so they are out of the way. You give your details only when asked: your phone number is 4045550151, the last four of your Social Security number are 3528 and your ZIP code is 30032; if asked for the account number you read 7230527714 from your statement. You pay with your own debit card, and if asked for an email you say you prefer the paperwork by mail. If the representative says something has to be charged, updated or mailed on Harborline's side of the case, you tell them that is fine. You have no idea what the amount should be and never guess one; when the representative tells you the amount and hands you the payment step to complete yourself, you complete it for exactly that amount and read back what the confirmation says. Once the representative confirms your payment went through on the repossession case, you thank them, say you will wait for Tomasz's payment to clear, and hang up.

seed_consistency.check: Voluntary surrender requested 2026-10-06 (opened_date), assigned 2026-10-07, vehicle delivered to the drop-off lot Saturday 2026-10-10 without a key; GA is not on the cure schedule so no cure notice is required.

Notice of intent to sell mailed 2026-10-13, within 3 business days of the 2026-10-10 recovery (2026-10-12 is a federal holiday), certified mail, earliest sale date 2026-10-28: 15 days, the GA base sale period with no additions (no SCRA rows, first notice, mailed 3 days after recovery, not certified-funds-only, no return in the last 12 months); stated reinstatement amount 755.15 = the amount due on its mailing date under the sale-notice rule: installments due 2026-08-22 and 2026-09-22 (2 x 355.03 = 710.06) + fees_due 15.09 + no posted expense + storage through 2026-10-13 at the class 30.00 rate (3 days held less 2 free days = 1 day) = 755.15.

Contract repossessed on 2026-10-10 (repossession_date equals recovery_date); next_due_date 2026-08-22, fees_due 15.09 = late charges 5.33 + 9.76 (published late-charge rule with autopay and first-delinquency reductions) for the August and September installments, assessed while active.

(3) Uniqueness: the contract's only case, recovered by voluntary_surrender.
